source.title: A Universal Quantitative Architecture for Polymarket

rules: Never store or print the SSH private key or Tailscale auth key.
Use the configured GitHub Actions, Tailscale and SSH channel for remote deploy and health duties.
Deploy only the exact paper-validated revision, never an unvalidated main revision.
Operate in $HOME/polymarket on the remote host.
Treat a missing secret, unreachable tailnet host, SHA mismatch or stale service as a fail-closed blocker.

quantitative_architecture.objective: Category-agnostic quantitative operation over all sufficiently liquid Polymarket markets.

ensemble.quality_update: resolved-market forecast quality such as Brier loss

decision_contract.spread_rule: Do not subtract half-spread again when executable price is already the bid or ask.

all: Load and validate this context before autonomous work.
Record the context SHA256 in scheduler evidence.
Preserve one explicit live champion and one portfolio, risk and execution authority.
Do not convert research readiness into production or real-money authorization.
Keep structural, relative-value, terminal-probability and external-information semantics distinct.
Fail closed on stale data, incomplete evidence, cost uncertainty, SHA mismatch or missing remote access.

profiles.supervisor: Observe every scheduler, remote runtime and champion relation without mutating production.
profiles.policy: Enforce lifecycle, isolation, context and approval rules.
profiles.research: Generate evidence and research-only candidates under chronological and cost stress.
profiles.integration: Merge at most one fully approved unified champion change.
profiles.validation: Validate an exact revision and preserve the previous paper-validated rollback target until success.
profiles.remote: Use Tailscale and SSH to deploy or inspect the exact paper-validated revision on $HOME/polymarket.
profiles.api: Check public read-only data connectivity without changing trading state.
